what: What can gene order constrain? ABC recovery of rearrangement parameters on simulated truth, with the nucleotide genome model.
api_call: genomes.simulate_genomes_nucleotide(tree, inversion=rate*n_genes, inversion_extent=extent_bp, translocation=rate*n_genes, translocation_extent=extent_bp, genes=..., gene_length=1000, chromosomes=8, root_length=..., topology='linear', seed=...)

design.rate_units: events per gene per unit of tree time

statistics.conservation: gene-order conservation, the normalised complement of the breakpoint distance
statistics.segment: mean conserved segment length, in genes
statistics.cross: fraction of broken adjacencies whose genes lie on different chromosomes

A.what: inversions only; grid over inversion rate x inversion extent

B.what: inversions and translocations; grid over the two rates, extent fixed at truth

C.what: the same observed data as arm B, fitted with the extent fixed at twice the truth
